subject: science
concept: Understanding the plant life cycle from seed to mature plant
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Life Science Disciplinary Core Ideas — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student observes (real or virtual) a seed growing over simulated time and describes each stage
exercise.pictorial: Student sequences life-cycle stage pictures in the correct order
exercise.abstract: Student names what comes next in a described plant life cycle stage

misconception_flags: places life cycle stages out of order

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
